Hi Samira — congrats on getting started with the trial, and welcome to Redwood. I'm Ben on the SDR team; looping Lauren in for visibility. Before we lock a demo, a couple quick questions so we keep the session focused and bring the right folks: 

1) Primary use case: you mentioned recommendations/search. Is this customer-facing personalization (end-user-facing) or internal ranking? Any example flows you want us to see?

2) Expected traffic profile: do you expect bursts (e.g., 500+ requests/min for short windows) or steady throughput? Can you share an estimate of concurrent gen requests or tokens per minute?

3) Timeline & goal: are you looking to validate in a week, run a pilot (4–8 weeks), or production (quarter+)?

4) Security/compliance: will SOC 2 / VPC/private deployment be required for the pilot or only later?

If you prefer to lock time, here are three 30-minute slots (I've set them up in ET):
- Tue Jun 22 — 10:00 AM ET
- Wed Jun 23 — 2:00 PM ET
- Thu Jun 24 — 11:00 AM ET

I attached a one-pager that summarizes what we'll demo and a quick pilot outline to help you prep. If none of those work, tell me a window that does and what timezone you're in and I can adjust.

Attachments: redwood_onepager.pdf, pilot-outline-template.docx

Thanks — Ben

Hi Ben — thanks for the quick reach out. Answers below so you can tailor the demo: 

1) Use case: customer-facing product recommendations shown in our web storefront and search results (re-rank + short blurb generation). We'll likely integrate via API; frontend team wants to see samples of structured output + prompt templating.

2) Volume: expected peak ~200 concurrent gen requests (we generally measure in requests/min). Typical payloads are ~400 tokens in + ~150 tokens out for recommendation context; we expect spikes during promotions up to ~600 reqs/min.

3) Timeline: pilot in ~6 weeks (aim to ship an MVP within Q3). We want a tech validation and cost estimate to present to product leadership.

4) Security: SOC 2 is required for production; for the pilot we can use hosted trial but will need guidance on Private/VPC options early in the pilot (especially KMS).

Timezone: I'm in ET (NYC). Tue Jun 22 10:00 AM ET would work best for me; I can invite our eng lead (Alex Chen) if needed.

Thanks — Samira
